interpretation: The included scBasset route is a local sequence-only profile baseline, not transfer from the public PBMC or hematopoietic heads. Within each outer fold it predicts accessibility for outer-training cells, averages predictions by frozen training-only cell state, and repeats that state profile across held donors. This passes the scientific modality boundary only if a fixed fixture proves that held-donor ATAC is absent. The native 32-dimensional cell embedding remains transductive and cannot score held cells.
remaining_blockers: Implement and fixture-test the sequence-only training-cell-state aggregation adapter; reject any inference bundle containing held-donor ATAC or held-cell output columns.
Activate GSE296875 only after donor/barcode/well/reference/peak/QC/missingness authorities pass; keep GSE244832 different-aliquot comparisons donor-compatible.
Replace random peak splitting with merged held genomic blocks plus a 1,344-bp boundary buffer and fit every peak/filter decision inside outer-training donors.

Resolve the released unseeded ambiguous-base encoding by rejecting ambiguous windows or validating a prespecified deterministic replacement; never allow random N encodings to vary across models or folds.
Replace training-AUROC checkpoint selection with a prespecified training-donor/genomic validation rule and freeze five seeds, training receipts, cell-state aggregation, and local HDF5 hashes.
Validate the legacy Python 3.7/TensorFlow 2.8 runtime, forward/backward, HDF5 restore, deterministic seeds, reverse-complement behavior, and numeric tolerances on L40S.
